summary: Geeftlist is a collaborative platform designed for managing, sharing, and reserving gifts among friends and family members. It helps groups coordinate gift-giving to avoid duplication and keep track of desired items. The software is packaged as a Docker container.
goodFor: It is suitable for families or social groups looking to self-host a private coordination tool for birthdays, holidays, and gift exchanges.
watchOut: The project currently has no tagged releases and zero repository stars, indicating very low community adoption and an unproven development history.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
